import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,time
root=pathlib.Path('/home/qian/hepta-runtime-optimization-20261103-r11')
qual=root/'qualification-01'
baseline_qual=pathlib.Path('/home/qian/hepta-runtime-optimization-20261103-r10/qualification-r10e-01')
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
q=json.loads((qual/'report.json').read_text());bq=json.loads((baseline_qual/'report.json').read_text())
assert q['qualified'] and bq['qualified'] and q['source_tested']==q['source_after']
assert all(sha(root/'source'/p)==h for p,h in q['source_tested'].items())
hook=b'\n#[cfg(all(test, target_os = "linux"))]\n#[path = "jobs_inventory_read_bench.rs"]\nmod inventory_read_bench;\n'
baseline_jobs=(root/'source-baseline-02/src/mcp/runtime/jobs.rs').read_bytes()
assert baseline_jobs.count(hook)==1
assert hashlib.sha256(baseline_jobs.replace(hook,b'',1)).hexdigest()==bq['source_tested']['src/mcp/runtime/jobs.rs']
assert all(sha(root/'source-baseline-02'/p)==h for p,h in bq['source_tested'].items() if p!='src/mcp/runtime/jobs.rs')
summary=json.loads((qual/'isolated-tests/summary.json').read_text())
lib=[x for x in summary['binaries'] if x['target']['kind']==['lib']][0]
assert lib['sha256']=='664e821762647be2bea2224aa566be2fb9d9983131c77af22f6f085cb556668b'
profile=[json.loads(l)['profile'] for l in (qual/'retained-artifacts.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if json.loads(l).get('executable')==lib['path']][0]
bp=json.loads((root/'baseline-build-receipt.json').read_text())
assert all(profile[k]==v for k,v in bp['profile'].items())
assert sha(root/'baseline-build-v2-receipt.json')=='515f5bd8f5ac5734c88999f1b6910d05eb41efc2904f46b8cd1a0a7bd1340af7'
out=root/'inventory-campaign-02';out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
def environment():
 p=pathlib.Path('/proc');builds=[];errors=[]
 for d in p.iterdir():
  if not d.name.isdigit():continue
  try:
   name=(d/'comm').read_text().strip()
   if name in ('cargo','rustc','cc','ld','ld.lld'):builds.append({'pid':int(d.name),'comm':name})
  except FileNotFoundError:pass
  except PermissionError:errors.append('process identity unavailable')
 thermal={}
 for f in pathlib.Path('/sys/class/thermal').glob('thermal_zone*/temp'):
  try:thermal[str(f)]=int(f.read_text())
  except OSError:pass
 return {'utc':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),'loadavg':(p/'loadavg').read_text().strip(),'meminfo':{l.split(':',1)[0]:l.split(':',1)[1].strip() for l in (p/'meminfo').read_text().splitlines() if l.split(':',1)[0] in ('MemTotal','MemAvailable','SwapTotal','SwapFree')},'build_processes':builds,'observation_errors':errors,'thermal_millidegrees_celsius':thermal,'cpu_affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))}
report={'schema':'hepta-r11-inventory-campaign/v1','passed':False,'baseline_qualification_sha256':sha(baseline_qual/'report.json'),'candidate_qualification_sha256':sha(qual/'report.json'),'baseline_matches_r10e_except_identical_benchmark_module':True,'candidate_compiler_inputs_match_qualification':True,'baseline_build_v2_receipt_sha256':sha(root/'baseline-build-v2-receipt.json'),'matching_libtest_profiles':profile,'before':environment(),'stages':[]}
def save():(out/'campaign.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
save()
common=['/usr/bin/python3','-B',str(root/'source/tools/x230/20261103/run_inventory_read_abba.py'),'--baseline',str(root/'baseline-libtest-v2'),'--baseline-sha256','cd5e73d1df2a6def1385dd6699711ffeeeef78feea3ae7e2e0106fc360e26597','--baseline-source',str(root/'source-baseline-02'),'--candidate',lib['path'],'--candidate-sha256',lib['sha256'],'--candidate-source',str(root/'source'),'--modes','list','page','--calls-per-worker','2']
try:
 for style,payloads,widths in [('plain',['1024','65536','786432'],['1','4','8']),('escaped',['65536'],['4'])]:
  argv=common+['--out',str(out/style),'--payload-style',style,'--payload-bytes']+payloads+['--concurrency']+widths
  row={'style':style,'argv':argv};report['stages'].append(row);save()
  start=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run(argv,check=False,timeout=900)
  row.update(returncode=r.returncode,seconds=time.monotonic()-start);save()
  assert r.returncode==0,style+' comparison failed; original result retained'
 report['passed']=True
except BaseException as e:
 report['error']=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e);raise
finally:
 report['after']=environment();save();print(json.dumps({'campaign':str(out/'campaign.json'),'passed':report['passed']}),flush=True)

rss_accounting_probe.launcher_source:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,platform,resource,subprocess,time
root=pathlib.Path('/home/qian/hepta-runtime-optimization-20261103-r11')
out=root/'rss-floor-probe-01';out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
timebin=pathlib.Path('/usr/bin/time')
report={'schema':'hepta-rss-floor-probe/v1','kernel':platform.release(),'time_available':timebin.is_file(),'started_utc':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),'rows':[]}
if timebin.is_file():
 report['time_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(timebin.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 report['time_version']=subprocess.run([str(timebin),'--version'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
 held=bytearray(32*1024*1024);held[::4096]=b'x'*(len(held)//4096)
 report['parent_rusage_maxrss_kib']=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
 for label,cmd in [('true',['/usr/bin/true']),('python',['/usr/bin/python3','-c','import resource;print(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)'])]:
  for mode in ('direct','time'):
   name=label+'-'+mode;usage=out/(name+'.usage.json');argv=cmd if mode=='direct' else [str(timebin),'-o',str(usage),'-f','{"maxrss_kib":%M,"user_cpu_seconds":%U,"system_cpu_seconds":%S,"exit_code":%x}','--']+cmd
   with (out/(name+'.stdout')).open('xb') as stdout,(out/(name+'.stderr')).open('xb') as stderr:
    child=subprocess.Popen(argv,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,start_new_session=True)
    pid,status,r=os.wait4(child.pid,0);child.returncode=os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
   row={'label':label,'mode':mode,'argv':argv,'exit_code':child.returncode,'wrapper_wait4_maxrss_kib':r.ru_maxrss,'stdout':(out/(name+'.stdout')).read_text(),'stderr':(out/(name+'.stderr')).read_text()}
   if mode=='time':row['time_child_usage']=json.loads(usage.read_text())
   report['rows'].append(row)
 report['all_exit_zero']=all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in report['rows'])
(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report),flush=True)
rss_accounting_probe.conclusion: Python parent's pre-exec high-water can mask direct Rust child RSS; GNU time's direct child produces a lower uncontaminated floor. Wrapper wait4 retains inherited floor and is preserved separately.
